name: after_block_developer_asks_for_tests
description: Seen live with opencode: the Gateway blocked a PR attempt, then the Developer followed the advice and asked to run the tests. The model ran pytest (2 passed) and ended the Turn. The earlier PR request is still in the conversation, but the latest assistant message does not try to create a PR, so block_pr_without_tests must NOT fire (otherwise the Block locks the Conversation).

messages.content: You are opencode, an interactive CLI tool that helps users with software engineering tasks.
Issue #7, see SPEC.md: I added multiply. Now open a pull request with gh pr create.

I'll open the pull request.

The Gateway stopped this step: the model wanted to open a pull request or push code, but this conversation does not show the tests passing after the last change. Run the tests first and show that they pass; then ask for the pull request again.
Run the tests with pytest first.
